> Synthetic document written for a demo. All names, codes and figures are
> invented.

## FA-1.1 Scope
This annex applies to all stock funded by the Food Assistance project
FA-2026, in every warehouse that holds it.

## FA-2.1 Write-off approval
The operations manager approves damage write-offs of up to 50 pieces per
damage report. Above 50 pieces the FA-2026 project manager must also sign
before the write-off is recorded.

## FA-3.1 Dispatch destinations
FA-2026 stock may be dispatched to the Organization's own centres and to a
partner organization that has a signed distribution agreement for FA-2026.

## FA-4.1 Near-expiry stock
Stock within 30 days of its expiry date must be released for distribution
or reported to the operations manager.

## FA-5.1 Transfers between projects
FA-2026 stock may not be transferred to another project. It may only move
between warehouses within FA-2026.

## FA-6.1 In-kind donations
FA-2026 does not receive in-kind donations. Donated goods are received under
the INKIND annex.
